# goslop text fixture — CWE-22 benchmark harness report path under fixed dir
lang: python
file: benchmark/harness.py
---
import json
from pathlib import Path


def write_report(pack, args):
    out_path = Path(args.out) if args.out else Path("benchmark/results") / f"{pack['pack_id']}_report.json"
    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out_path.write_text(json.dumps({"ok": True}, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return out_path
